about: compiler/nativeabi: pure-Ergo DoD ABI contract mirror covering Perceus RC capacity encoding, C11 struct alignment and padding, builtin runtime ABI layouts, and runtime symbol table contracts.

mutants.name: nativeabi-rc-encode-mask-dropped
mutants.rule: EncodeRCFlags must mask userFlags to RCUserFlagsMask so stray flag bits cannot corrupt capacity bits.

mutants.name: nativeabi-rc-encode-large-page-shift
mutants.rule: EncodeRCFlags must page-shift capacities exceeding RCCapMaxExact and mark RCFlagCapShifted.

mutants.name: nativeabi-rc-decode-cap-unshifted
mutants.rule: DecodeRCCapacity must scale page-shifted capacities back by RCCapPageShift.

mutants.name: nativeabi-rc-static-zero-cap
mutants.rule: DecodeRCCapacity must recover payloadSize for static headers initialized without encoded upper capacity bits.

mutants.name: nativeabi-rc-header-size-misaligned
mutants.rule: PayloadOffsetFromHeader must attest that RCHeaderSize preserves MaxAlign payload alignment.

mutants.name: nativeabi-alignup-no-pow2-check
mutants.rule: AlignUp must reject non-power-of-two alignments with InvalidLayout.

mutants.name: nativeabi-alignup-no-round
mutants.rule: AlignUp must round n up to the next multiple of align.

mutants.name: nativeabi-layout-allow-empty
mutants.rule: ComputeStructLayout must reject empty C11 struct field lists.

mutants.name: nativeabi-layout-skip-field-align
mutants.rule: ComputeStructLayout must align each field offset to its declared alignment.

mutants.name: nativeabi-layout-overlap-cursor
mutants.rule: ComputeStructLayout must advance cursor past off + f.Size so subsequent fields never overlap padding.

mutants.name: nativeabi-layout-wrong-max-align
mutants.rule: ComputeStructLayout must track the maximum field alignment for tail padding and struct alignment.

mutants.name: nativeabi-layout-skip-tail-pad
mutants.rule: ComputeStructLayout must pad total struct size to a multiple of maxAlign.

mutants.name: nativeabi-layout-dup-struct-accepted
mutants.rule: AddStruct must refuse duplicate struct registrations.

mutants.name: nativeabi-layout-error-no-pad
mutants.rule: BuiltinLayoutTable must preserve the explicit _pad field of ErgoError matching runtime/native/ergo_rt.h.

mutants.name: nativeabi-symbols-die-wrong-ret
mutants.from: pushSymbol(&t, symbolSpec{name: "ergo_die", group: SymGroupDie, ret: ABITypeVoid, mayTrap: true, params: []uint8{ABITypeU32, ABITypeStr}})
mutants.to: pushSymbol(&t, symbolSpec{name: "ergo_die", group: SymGroupDie, ret: ABITypeU32, mayTrap: true, params: []uint8{ABITypeU32, ABITypeStr}})
mutants.rule: BuiltinRuntimeSymbols must record ABITypeVoid as the return type of _Noreturn ergo_die.

mutants.name: nativeabi-symbols-reuse-wrong-arity
mutants.from: pushSymbol(&t, symbolSpec{name: "ergo_rc_reuse_or_alloc", group: SymGroupRC, ret: ABITypePtr, mayTrap: false, params: []uint8{ABITypePtr, ABITypeU32, ABITypeU32, ABITypePtr}})
mutants.to: pushSymbol(&t, symbolSpec{name: "ergo_rc_reuse_or_alloc", group: SymGroupRC, ret: ABITypePtr, mayTrap: false, params: []uint8{ABITypePtr, ABITypeU32, ABITypeU32}})
mutants.rule: BuiltinRuntimeSymbols must record all 4 parameters of ergo_rc_reuse_or_alloc.

mutants.name: nativeabi-symbols-maytrap-wrong
mutants.from: pushSymbol(&t, symbolSpec{name: "ergo_actor_step", group: SymGroupActor, ret: ABITypeVoid, mayTrap: true, params: []uint8{ABITypeU32}})
mutants.to: pushSymbol(&t, symbolSpec{name: "ergo_actor_step", group: SymGroupActor, ret: ABITypeVoid, mayTrap: false, params: []uint8{ABITypeU32}})
mutants.rule: BuiltinRuntimeSymbols must mark trapping runtime entrypoints with mayTrap=true.

mutants.name: nativeabi-symbols-slice-bounds
mutants.rule: SymbolParams must return the full parameter slice for the requested symbol.

mutants.name: nativeabi-symbols-type-size-zero
mutants.rule: ABITypeSizeBytes must report non-zero byte width for by-value ABI structs.
